articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Extended Reasoning and Native Multimodal Generation
articles.summary: OpenAI officially released GPT-5, featuring significantly improved long-horizon reasoning, native image and audio generation, and a unified architecture that merges the previously separate o-series reasoning models into a single system. The model demonstrates substantial gains on graduate-level science benchmarks and complex multi-step coding tasks, narrowing the gap between AI assistants and domain experts in several fields.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini 2.5 Ultra Sets New State of the Art on Agentic Benchmarks
articles.summary: Google DeepMind released Gemini 2.5 Ultra with a 2-million-token context window and advanced agentic capabilities that allow it to autonomously browse the web, write and execute code, and orchestrate multi-step workflows. The model topped SWE-Bench Verified and several new agentic evaluation suites, intensifying competition with OpenAI and Anthropic in the enterprise AI agent market.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Robots Begin Limited Deployment in Third-Party Warehouses
articles.summary: Tesla confirmed that its Optimus Gen-3 humanoid robots have started operating in select third-party logistics warehouses outside of Tesla's own factories, marking the company's first commercial deployment to external customers. The robots handle bin picking, palletizing, and inventory scanning tasks, leveraging end-to-end neural network control trained in simulation and refined with real-world teleoperation data.

articles.title: Figure and BMW Expand Humanoid Robot Deployment Across European Assembly Lines
articles.summary: Figure AI announced an expanded partnership with BMW to deploy its Figure 02 humanoid robots across multiple European manufacturing plants, scaling from a single pilot line to full body-shop and logistics roles. The robots use a vision-language-action model that allows operators to assign new tasks via natural language instructions, significantly reducing reprogramming time compared to traditional industrial automation.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Claude Tool-Use Orchestration Framework for Enterprise Agents
articles.summary: Anthropic launched a new orchestration layer for Claude that enables enterprises to build complex multi-agent systems with built-in guardrails, audit logging, and human-in-the-loop approval gates. The framework addresses growing demand for controllable AI agents in regulated industries such as finance and healthcare, providing deterministic fallback paths when model confidence is low.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 2nm A16 Chips with Backside Power Delivery
articles.summary: TSMC has commenced high-volume manufacturing of its A16 (2nm-class) process node featuring backside power delivery network technology, which routes power through the back of the wafer to free up routing resources on the front side. Early yield data reportedly exceeds expectations, and the node is expected to power next-generation AI accelerators and smartphone SoCs shipping in late 2026 and early 2027.

articles.title: EU AI Act Enforcement Begins with First Wave of Compliance Audits
articles.summary: The European Union's AI Office initiated its first formal compliance audits under the AI Act, targeting providers of general-purpose AI models with systemic risk classifications. Companies including major US and Chinese AI labs operating in the EU must demonstrate adherence to transparency, safety testing, and energy reporting requirements or face fines of up to 3% of global revenue.

articles.title: Neuralink Receives FDA Clearance for Second-Generation Brain-Computer Interface Implant
articles.summary: Neuralink obtained FDA approval for its N2 implant, a second-generation brain-computer interface with four times the electrode count of its predecessor and a wireless data throughput sufficient for real-time cursor and robotic arm control. The clearance covers expanded clinical trials for patients with spinal cord injuries and ALS, building on promising data from the first cohort of human participants implanted in 2024-2025.
